note: Adding a newly released image editor is a row here, not a code change. Every row records the terms the model may be used under, because these artifacts reach customers. An entry without recorded terms is refused rather than defaulted.

backends.notes: Upstream bundles several components; treat as non-commercial until each is cleared individually.

Locally hosted weights, NOT the hosted-API path. Retiring it is not a row deletion: the bundle pins QWEN_IMAGE_EDIT_REPOSITORY, QWEN_IMAGE_EDIT_REVISION and a large-files download list, so removing it means removing that weights path and its tests.

No implementation is bound to this id -- it is the allowlist token meaning 'a hosted API editor produced these frames', which is the APIs-on-our-own-captures path. Which model, and on whose terms, is recorded per run in editor_identity, so following a newer hosted model needs no change here. The name is inherited from the frozenset this registry replaced and names nothing on its own.
